<thought>We need the precursors for the bromination template (ID 1141). The retrosynthetic step breaks the C‑Br bond, giving the parent aromatic (dimethylbenzene) and Br₂. So the precursors are the dimethylbenzene SMILES and Br₂ SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[['Cc1ccc(C)cc1','BrBr']]</final_answer>
